thread:
maria: heads-up  rwd-v6-slim int4 onboard into canary (6%) shows progressive coherence drop in long multi-turn summaries. not a single-shot failure, but by turn 10+ the factuality score falls ~7%.
devon: link: https://dash.internal/redwood/onboard/rwd-v6-slim/int4  looks like a session-length problem, short sessions OK. any latency change?
yara: p95 latency slightly better (-8ms). quality drift concentrated on sessions with avg_turns >= 8 and many context-rollbacks.
maria: initial triage: possible kv-cache quantization degradation over long KV chains. two quick mitigations: 1) session-aware holdout route for long sessions to fp32 2) session pinning: once a session is routed to fp32 keep it pinned for rest of session.
devon: propose concrete gate: if session.turns >= 8 AND coherence_delta >= 0.05 -> route whole session to rwd-v6-stable-fp32. also shrink canary to 2% while holdout is active.
yara: +1. also we should increase shadowing for long-session cohort to 100% so we get more A/B samples fast.
ops-bot: queued change: adjust-canary rwd-v6-slim int4 -> {canary:2%, holdout_long_sessions:active, shadow_long_sessions:100%}. monitor MON_SESSION_HOLDOUT_1811111111 created.
ci-bot: quick sanity: rollout-config PR check passed locally for the holdout rule.
maria: config snippet for rollout policy (paste into rollout rules):
```
rule: session_length_holdout
match: session.turns >= 8
metrics_trigger: coherence_delta >= 0.05
action: route_to: rwd-v6-stable-fp32
session_pin: true
hysteresis: min_pin_duration_mins: 30
```
devon: also add thermostat: if overall coherence_delta > 0.06 for 20m shrink canary by 50% and page #eng-oncall. if thermostat trips twice -> auto-pause.
yara: agree. we must watch for any p95 latency regression from pinning; pinning to fp32 could add ~70-100ms on some paths. add telemetry guard: if pinned_session_p95_latency_increase > 120ms for 10m -> auto-pause and notify #eng-oncall.
maria: deploying the holdout now. ops-bot, apply routing override for active sessions and reduce canary weight.
ops-bot: change applied. canary now 2%, long-session holdout active, shadowing at 100%. alert:SESSION_HOLDOUT_ACTIVE_1811111111.
devon: ran a 6h replay with the holdout rules on staging: coherence for long sessions returns to baseline in replay, but sample size still small. attaching traces to the onboard ticket.
yara: owner: devon 12h watch, maria owns gate config PR, i'll add long-session cohort to nightly eval with focused metrics (coherence, hallucination_rate, latency).
ci-bot: PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/rollout-config/pull/912, CI checks passed.
maria: note: do not globally patch session pinning until we validate that pinned sessions don't introduce customer-visible latency regressions. keep holdout for 24h and collect shadowed samples.
devon: adding additional logging for KV cache miss/hit pattern for long sessions to see if cache decay correlates.
yara: good. if we see rapid improvement in shadow stats we can step canary up slowly (2x every 6h) with thermostat engaged.
maria: follow-up in 4h with early numbers. if any alert fires we rollback to rwd-v6-stable-fp32 globally.
deploy-bot: holdout change recorded: HOLDOUT_SESSION_1811111111. will auto-revert after 24h unless extended.
ops-bot: monitor configured to page on thermostat trip.
devon: thanks team. posting interim chart in 3h. :thumbsup:
